title: Employee - Data API
description: Represents an employee within a company or organization. This object is available in API version 48.0 and later. In API version 49.0 and later, this object supports reports, criteria-based sharing rules, and history tracking, plus you can exclude individual fields from custom page layouts.

AboutMe.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
AboutMe.description: Information about the employee, such as areas of interest or skills. Values can be provided on Employee’s profile page. This field is available even if Chatter is disabled.

AlternateEmail.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update

Availability.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
Availability.description: The employee’s availability status. Possible values are: In The Office Out Of Office Out Sick PTO Volunteering Time Off Working Remotely

AvailabilityEndDate.description: The end date of the Employee’s availability, inclusive of the date.

AvailabilityStartDate.description: The start date of the Employee’s availability, inclusive of the date.

BannerPhotoUrl.description: Read only. The URL for the employee's banner photo. Available in API v51.0 and later.

CurrentWellnessStatus.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
CurrentWellnessStatus.description: The employee’s current wellness status. Possible values are: Available To Work Remote Work Only Unavailable Unknown

DateOfBirth.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update

Email.properties: Create, Filter, Group, idLookup, Nillable, Sort, Update
Email.description: The employee’s email address. This field is unique within your organization.

EmployeeNumber.properties: Create, Filter, Group, idLookup, Sort, Update
EmployeeNumber.description: The employee's employment ID for the organization they were hired into. This field is unique within your organization.

EmployeeStatus.description: The employee's current work status. Possible values are: Active Inactive Leave Terminated

EmploymentType.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
EmploymentType.description: The employee's full-time or part-time status. Possible values are: Full-Time Part-Time

FullPhotoUrl.description: Read only. The URL for the employee's profile photo. The URL is updated every time a photo is uploaded and reflects the most recent photo. If a newer photo has been uploaded, the URL returned for an older photo isn’t guaranteed to return a photo. Query this field for the URL of the most recent photo. Available in API v51.0 and later.

Gender.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
Gender.description: The employee’s gender. Possible values are: Female Male Non-Binary / Non-Conforming Other Prefer Not to State Transgender Female Transgender Male

HomeCity.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
HomeCity.description: The city for the employee’s home address.

HomeCountry.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
HomeCountry.description: The county for the employee’s home address.

HomeGeocodeAccuracy.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
HomeGeocodeAccuracy.description: The level of accuracy of an employee’s home address geographical coordinates compared with its physical address. A geocoding service typically provides this value based on the address’s latitude and longitude coordinates. Possible values are: Address Block City County ExtendedZip NearAddress Neighborhood State Street Unknown Zip

HomeLatitude.description: Used with HomeLongitude to specify the precise geolocation of the employee’s home address. Acceptable values are numbers between –90 and 90 with up to 15 decimal places.

HomeLongitude.description: Used with HomeLatitude to specify the precise geolocation of the employee’s home address. Acceptable values are numbers between –180 and 180 with up to 15 decimal places.

HomePhone.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update

HomePostalCode.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
HomePostalCode.description: The postal code for the employee’s home address.

HomeState.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
HomeState.description: The state for the employee’s home address.

HomeStreet.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
HomeStreet.description: The street for the employee’s home address.

IndividualId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
IndividualId.description: A reference to the Individual record that this employee is assigned to.

InternalOrganizationUnitId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
InternalOrganizationUnitId.description: A reference to the InternalOrganizationUnit this employee is assigned to.

JobProfile.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
JobProfile.description: The employee’s job profile at the company.

LastReferencedDate.description: The timestamp for when the current user last viewed a record related to this record.

LastViewedDate.description: The timestamp for when the current user last viewed this record. If this value is null, this record might only have been referenced (LastReferencedDate) and not viewed.

LocationId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
LocationId.description: A reference to the Location that this employee is assigned to.

ManagerId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
ManagerId.description: A reference to the Employee record of the employee's manager.

MediumPhotoUrl.description: Read only. The URL for the medium-sized employee's profile photo. The URL is updated every time a photo is uploaded and reflects the most recent photo. If a newer photo has been uploaded, the URL returned for an older photo isn’t guaranteed to return a photo. Query this field for the URL of the most recent photo. Available in API v51.0 and later.

MiddleName.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update

Name.description: A compound field of Employee.FirstName, Employee.MiddleName, and Employee.LastName.

NameSuffix.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update

OutOfOfficeMessage.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
OutOfOfficeMessage.description: The message portion of the employee availability. This message can provide reasons or details about the change in availability. The maximum length of this string is 40 characters.

OwnerId.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
OwnerId.description: The ID of the user who currently owns this record. Default value is the user logged in to the API to perform the create operation.

PreferredFirstName.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
PreferredFirstName.description: The name the employee prefers to be called.

PreferredPronoun.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
PreferredPronoun.description: The employee's preferred pronoun. Possible values are: He/Him/His Other/Ask Me She/Her/Hers They/Them/Theirs

RelatedPersonId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
RelatedPersonId.description: Links an employee to a person account with a unique value. Reserved for future use. Don’t edit it.

SmallPhotoUrl.description: Read only. The URL for the small-sized employee's profile photo. The URL is updated every time a photo is uploaded and reflects the most recent photo. If a newer photo has been uploaded, the URL returned for an older photo isn’t guaranteed to return a photo. Query this field for the URL of the most recent photo. Available in API v51.0 and later.

StatusAsOf.description: Start date of the employee’s current status.

StatusEndDate.description: Planned end date for the employee’s status.

TimeZone.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
TimeZone.description: The time zone which the employee’s work hours fall within.

UserId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
UserId.description: Lookup field to associate an Employee record with a user in the org. The field is optional and unique.

WorkPhone.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
WorkPhone.description: The employee's formatted work phone number including country code and extension.

WorkerType.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
WorkerType.description: The type of worker for the employee. Possible values are: Alumnus Contractor Employee Intern Temporary

WorkingHoursEnd.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
WorkingHoursEnd.description: The end time of the employee’s working hours.

WorkingHoursStart.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
WorkingHoursStart.description: The start time of the employee’s working hours.

special_access_rules: To access this object, you must have a Workplace Command Center permission set license and the Provides access to Workplace Command Center features system permission or have the Employee Management and Employee User add-on licenses.
associated_objects:
This object has the following associated objects. Unless noted, they’re available in the same API version as this object.

- **EmployeeHistory (API version 49.0)**: History is available for tracked fields of the object.
- **EmployeeOwnerSharingRule**: Sharing rules are available for the object.
- **EmployeesShare (API version 49.0)**: Sharing is available for the object.
